name: abiden-mobile
description: Capacitor native shell for Abide N Me. Wraps the same web app served at https://abiden.me.

scripts.sync: npm run sync:www && npx cap sync && node scripts/android-extras.mjs
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && npx cap run android
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync && npx cap run ios
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.build:aab: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs bundleRelease
